pairs.locus: Abelard, Dialogus inter Philosophum, Iudaeum et Christianum (Philosophus-Christianus exchange on the way to the highest good)
pairs.question: Et quam, rogo, viam ad hoc summum bonum, id est virtutem, perveniendi constituebant?
pairs.answer: Ipsum prorecto moralis lectionis studium vel domandae carnis exercitium, ut bona in habitum solidata voluntas virtus dici queat.
pairs.derivation: Christianus asks a real interrogative (quam viam... constituebant?), and the Philosophus answers directly. Dropped the speaker labels 'Christianus:' and 'Philosophus:' as drama/dialogue scaffolding. The answer is a single sentence to its first full stop; nothing was trimmed from it. Question quoted verbatim including the speaker's own interjection 'rogo'.

pairs.locus: Abelard, Dialogus inter Philosophum, Iudaeum et Christianum (Philosophus-Christianus exchange defining the blessed man)
pairs.question: Et quem esse beatum definiunt?
pairs.answer: Beatum quasi bene aptum dicunt, hoc est in omnibus bene et facile se agentem, ut idem sit scilicet beatum esse, quod bonis moribus, id est virtutibus, pollere.
pairs.derivation: Christianus poses a genuine interrogative (quem... beatum definiunt?) and the Philosophus answers it directly with a definition. Dropped the 'Christianus:' and 'Philosophus:' speaker labels. The answer is one contiguous sentence to its full stop; nothing omitted internally.
